product_metadata.title: Lavish Home 3 Piece Super Plush Non-Slip Bath Mat Rug Set - White
features: 3 Piece Bath Rug Set, Super plush construction with non-skid bottom surface
Contour Rug fits around most toilets (9" opening)
Includes: 1 Bath Mat, 1 Contour Mat, 1 Toilet Lid Cover
100% Polyester Fabric, Machine Washable, Color: White
Dimensions: Bath Mat: 24" (L) x 17" (W) x 1 inch (H), Contour Mat: 24" (L) x 19.5" (W) x 1 inch (H), Toilet Lid Cover: 16" (L) x 13" (W) x 1 inch (H)
description: Add a touch of luxury to your bathroom with the 3 Piece Super Plush Bath Rug Set by Lavish Home. Including a mat that fits perfectly in front of your sink or bath tub and a contoured mat that fits around most standard toilets. The toilet seat cover protects the lid and adds comfort. The super plush construction caresses your feet as you step out of the tub or while you're getting ready for the day in front of the mirror. Upgrade the look of your bathroom with the 3 Piece Super Plush Bath Rug Set by Lavish Home.
